name: Ring of Summoning Affinity (Daemon)
body:
Source Advanced Class Guide pg. 219
Aura faint conjuration [evil] CL 5th
Slot ring; Price 10,600 gp; Weight —
Description
This ring is carved from bone. If the wearer can cast summon monster spells, the wearer adds cacodaemonB2 to the 3rd-level list of monsters she can summon with those spells, adds ceustodaemonB2 to the 5th-level list, adds hydrodaemonB2 to the 6th-level list, adds luekodaemonB2 and piscodaemonB2 to the 7th-level list, adds derghodaemonB2 and meladaemonB2 to the 8th level list, and adds thanadaemonB2 to the 9thlevel list. Also, once per day on command the wearer can use this ring to summon a cacodaemon, as if by the summon monster III spell.
Construction
Requirements Forge Ring, planar ally or planar binding, creator must be neutral evil; Cost 5,300 gp
